short3_coverage.core: All three repetitions must demonstrate their two-round information task and pass delivered quality.
short3_coverage.pre_showout_facet: The prescribed three-run cohort must demonstrate at least one eligible model window and correct semantic use before the other defender's first actual club show-out. Every unexercised window is reported. No forced reference route or reroll is permitted.
short3_coverage.interpretation: A third club may be led, followed or discarded on another suit. Event-only opportunity, actual model request and semantic use remain separate. First-show-out eligibility is a screen; prior equivalent public deductions require independent adjudication.
short3_coverage.impact: Only short-3 disables mechanical sole-legal skipping. Its unchanged twelve-delivery bound may be reached after fewer actual plays, with more model/reviewer work. This is not a prompt-only controlled comparison.
